name: Browser minimap
author: Marco Ripamonti
description: A live minimap of whatever agent-browser is looking at, pinned to the top right.

barWidget.description: Toggles the agent-browser minimap and shows when a page is painting.

schema.label: Enabled
schema.description: Off stops the bridge process entirely; the bar icon toggles this.

schema.label: Frames per second
schema.description: Capped server-side by agent-browser. Higher costs CPU inside omarchy-shell.

schema.label: Click-through
schema.description: When on, the minimap never takes pointer input and cannot be expanded by clicking.

schema.label: Monitor
schema.description: Output name to pin the minimap to (e.g. HDMI-A-1). Empty follows the focused monitor.

schema.label: Hide after idle (seconds)
schema.description: Hide once the page stops painting for this long. 0 keeps the minimap up for as long as a browser session exists.

schema.label: Max visible stretch (seconds)
schema.description: Cap on one stretch of visibility, so a page that animates forever cannot pin the minimap up. A navigation or a change after a quiet spell starts a new stretch. 0 removes the cap.

schema.label: Log presence decisions
schema.description: Writes show/hide reasoning to the omarchy-shell journal tag. Useful when tuning the two timeouts.

schema.label: Sessions
schema.description: agent-browser session names to watch, comma separated. Empty watches every session.

schema.label: Session rail width (px)
schema.description: Width of the session list shown down the left of the card when more than one session is live. It is added to the card, not taken out of the mirror.

schema.label: Show the action feed
schema.description: Names each action the agent performs in the bottom right of the mirror.

schema.label: Show the agent's pointer
schema.description: Draws a marker and fading trail where the agent acts. Resolving a target's position costs one read-only query per action into that session; off, the bridge never issues a command of any kind.

schema.label: Pointer colour
schema.description: Any QML colour. It sits over arbitrary web pages rather than the shell's own surfaces, so it does not follow the theme accent by default.

panel.description: Mirrors the active agent-browser session's viewport while a coding agent drives it.
